column5: I would advise getting the LOP power supply unless you already have a EPP series on hand. The LOP is newer, smaller, and the 300W LOP is the same price as a 200W EPP. Either the 200W or 300W one will work fine.
3 Pin Connector for the AC in. These are a little hard to find
6 Pin Connector for the DC out. These are a little hard to find
Crimped contacts for the 18 AWG AC in and 16 AWG DC out wires. You should probably buy a few extra.
Crimped contacts for the 22 AWG JST lead for the cooling fan. Optional if you decide to power the fan from the MCU board. You should probably buy a few extra.
Used to connect the fan to the 24V DC out. Needs to be 22 AWG. Optional if you decide to power the fan from the MCU board.
The important thing is to make sure its the correct style as seen in the instructions and link.
Buy which ever length you need.
Should be 24V unless you plan to power it off the PSU boards specific fan connector in which case you will need 12V.
Cut to length for 24V DC out. While the amount needed varies 175mm(7in) Should be enough for most setups.
This is for the gap between the PSU and MCU enclosures.
